# Objective

- Fixes #15897

## Solution

- Despawn light view entities when they go unused or when the corresponding view is not alive.

## Testing

- `scene_viewer` example no longer prints "The preprocessing index buffer wasn't present" warning
- modified an example to try toggling shadows for all kinds of light: https://gist.github.com/akimakinai/ddb0357191f5052b654370699d2314cf
pr_comments: @akimakinai can you test this on WASM and investigate the failure please?
Ok, this fixed the crash locally.

issue_context.title: `scene_viewer` example prints warnings after toggling shadow on and off
issue_context.body:
## Bevy version

main

This does not reproduce with v0.14.2.

## What you did

- Run `scene_viewer` example and toggle shadow on and off (press <kbd>U</kbd>)

## What went wrong

No visual problem, but this warning appears repeatedly in terminal:
`WARN bevy_pbr::render::gpu_preprocess: The preprocessing index buffer wasn't present`

## Additional information

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/82d6f56cfc3432f584632f761c44ec8efd2e7c67/crates/bevy_pbr/src/render/light.rs#L1198-L1206

Hitting these conditions cause living (due to now retained render world) entitiy to be removed from `live_shadow_mapping_lights` in this function, hence removed from `ViewBinnedRenderPhases`, and later disagrees with query result in `GpuPreprocessNode::run`.

<!-- I thought I could simply despawn entities before `continue` to fix this, but I failed to understand the code around (what do offsets do? Isn't `light_view_entities` managed per-entity?). -->
